scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy
scripts.check: npm run test && npm --prefix functions test && npm run build
scripts.test:full: npm run check && node scripts/prepare-emulator.cjs && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-paperbridge "node scripts/emulator-check.cjs"
scripts.format: prettier --write src functions/src tests scripts docs README.md
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
